objective: Complete the R79 conv-versus-delta isolation by separating true multi-request verifier calls from narrower follow-up scheduler calls without changing the R35/R50 one-request diagnostic or any production default.

code_boundary.dispatch: With the new gate and exactly one split stage armed, num_spec_decodes greater than one uses the R80 multi-request serial path; later one-request calls use the unchanged ordinary kernel.

decision: A stage is implicated only if its arm returns two complete 128-token outputs, both exactly match the R72 oracle, cached_tokens are both zero, its R80 marker appears on both TP ranks, and no new GPU/Xe/OOM fault occurs. If both or neither pass, no single-stage causal claim is allowed.
promotion_boundary: Diagnostic only on this boot. A resulting fix still requires clean-boot varied prose/code/document identity, deterministic repeats, context-depth coverage, concurrency coverage, and preservation of the current speed floor before recipe or site promotion.
